topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Hey, I just got this package, and it's literally not for me, you know? It’s got the old tenant’s name on it, and I’m thinking, what if it’s something really important? Like, what if they’re missing this, and it’s a big deal or something? I didn’t even know the person, but I feel like I should do the right thing and get it to them. But how, right? I don’t have their new address, and I’m not sure if they’re even in town anymore. It’s just sitting there, and I’m not sure what to do. I hope you can give me some ideas. It’s weighing on me, you know?
